unit.title: Engineering a Reliable Linear Regression Baseline
unit.scope: Implement and test multivariable ordinary least-squares linear regression using deterministic batch gradient descent.
learning_objectives: Connect the least-squares objective and its gradient to an executable implementation.
Design a small, explicit estimator API with validation and fitted-state contracts.
Use deterministic tests and an independent numerical reference to establish correctness.
Diagnose convergence and numerical failures from recorded evidence rather than intuition.

unit_completion_requires: All required learner artifacts are present.
Harness-controlled tests and validation checks pass.
An independent examiner applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md and records a passing result.
The comprehension response is complete and consistent with the submitted implementation.
